# Separator

A line between groups.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span> Breaks between parts of a page.</p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Separating groups that spacing alone does not separate.
- **Not when:** Decoration between every item: spacing is quieter.

Instead:

- [Card](./card.md): A container, when groups need a boundary.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Between page sections</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> space.gap.section, no line</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A divider line</div></div><div class="cap">Space alone separates sections; lines add noise.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add separator
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
